proposals.before: During the Xiahou time, some were lost and some continued.
proposals.after: During the time of the Xia rulers, some were lost and some continued.
proposals.reason: 夏后 means Xia rulers, not the name Xiahou.

proposals.before: In the fifteenth year, Duke Ling drank with his two sons at the Xia clan.
proposals.after: In the fifteenth year, Duke Ling drank with the two men at the Xia clan.
proposals.reason: 二子 here refers to Kong Ning and Yi Xingfu (the two officers), not Duke Ling's sons.

proposals.after: The two men said: 'He also resembles you, my lord.'
proposals.reason: 二子 means the two officers, not sons; 公 is the duke addressed.

proposals.before: Eight generations after, none rival with Jing.'
proposals.after: After eight generations, none will rival them in greatness.
proposals.reason: 京 means capital/greatness, not the personal name Jing.

proposals.before: In the seventh year, the three younger brothers of Crown Prince Mian of Duke Huan, whom Duke Li had killed—the eldest named Yue, the middle named Lin, the youngest named Chu Jiu—together commanded the Cai people to lure Duke Li with beautiful women, and together with the Cai people killed Duke Li and established Yue, who became Duke Li.
proposals.after: In the seventh year, the three younger brothers of Crown Prince Mian of Duke Huan, whom Duke Li had killed—the eldest named Yue, the middle named Lin, the youngest named Chu Jiu—together commanded the Cai people to lure Duke Li with beautiful women, and together with the Cai people killed Duke Li and established Yue, who became Duke Li (利公).
proposals.reason: The closing title 利公 is a different style from 厲公, both rendered Duke Li; mark 利公 distinctly.

proposals.before: Having executed Xia Zheng Shu, he therefore suspended Chen and possessed it. All the ministers congratulated him.
proposals.after: Having executed Xia Zheng Shu, he therefore made Chen a county and took possession of it. All the ministers congratulated him.
proposals.reason: 縣陳 means to organize Chen as a county, not to suspend it.

proposals.before: In the twenty-ninth year, Chen doubled-crossed the Chu alliance.
proposals.after: In the twenty-ninth year, Chen betrayed the Chu alliance.
proposals.reason: 倍 means betray/turn against; 'doubled-crossed' is a misleading calque.

proposals.before: Light thousand chariot state but heavy one word.'
proposals.after: He treated lightly a state of a thousand chariots but valued a single word.'
proposals.reason: Telegraphic literal obscures the 輕/重 contrast.

proposals.before: Zhao what killed Dao crown prince, crown prince's son named Wu, fled Jin.
proposals.after: When Zhao killed the Dao crown prince, the crown prince's son named Wu fled to Jin.
proposals.reason: Broken grammar ('Zhao what killed') and missing preposition before Jin.

proposals.before: Ping Wang first ascended, desired obtain harmony feudal lords, then sought former Chen Dao crown prince Shi's son Wu, established as Chen Hou, this was Hui Gong.
proposals.after: When Ping Wang first ascended, he desired to obtain harmony among the feudal lords; he then sought Wu, son of the former Chen Dao crown prince Shi, established him as Chen Hou—this was Hui Gong.
proposals.reason: Telegraphic fragments omit needed grammar and obscure clause structure.

proposals.before: When King Ping had just ascended, he wished to restore harmony among the feudal lords, so he sought out Wu, the son of the former Crown Prince Shi of Duke Dao of Chen, and established him as lord of Chen. This was Duke Hui.
proposals.after: When King Ping had just ascended, he wished to restore harmony among the feudal lords, so he sought out Wu, the son of Chen's former Crown Prince Dao Shi, and established him as lord of Chen. This was Duke Hui.
proposals.reason: 悼太子師 is Crown Prince Dao named Shi; 'Duke Dao' invents a non-existent duke.

proposals.before: Qi Dong Lou Gong was Xiahou Yu's descendants posterity.
proposals.after: Qi Dong Lou Gong was a descendant of Yu of the Xia rulers.
proposals.reason: Literal English is ungrammatical ('descendants posterity') and obscures the singular descendant sense of 之後苗裔.

proposals.before: Duke Ping died in his eighteenth year. His son Duke Dao Cheng Li ascended.
proposals.after: Duke Ping died in his eighteenth year. His son Duke Dao Cheng ascended.
proposals.reason: Literal invents the name element 'Li' not present in 悼公成.

proposals.before: Qi's descendants became Yin. Yin has basic annals that speak of this.
proposals.after: Xie's descendants became Yin. Yin has basic annals that speak of this.
proposals.reason: 契 is the person Xie; rendering it as 'Qi' confuses him with the state name Qi.

proposals.before: Yin was broken. Zhou enfeoffed their descendants at Song. Duke Min of Qi extinguished them. There are hereditary houses that speak of this.
proposals.after: Yin was broken. Zhou enfeoffed their descendants at Song. King Min of Qi extinguished them. There are hereditary houses that speak of this.
proposals.reason: 齊湣王 is a king (王), not a duke; the idiomatic field correctly has King Min.

proposals.before: King Hui of Chu extinguished Qi. His descendants' King Gou Jian of Yue rose.
proposals.after: King Hui of Chu extinguished Qi. Later, King Gou Jian of Yue rose.
proposals.reason: 其后 here is temporal 'afterward/later', not 'his descendants'; the literal invents a kinship link to King Hui.

decisions.reason: 夏后 denotes the Xia ruling house (Xia rulers), not a personal or clan name Xiahou; the proposed wording restores that sense.
In the preceding unit 靈公以告二子, 二子 are the officers Kong Ning and Yi Xingfu, not Duke Ling's sons; the repair removes the false kinship.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 靈公以告二子，二子請殺泄冶……十五年，靈公與二子飲於夏氏。

decisions.reason: 二子 again names those two officers, and 公 is the duke addressed as 'my lord,' not a transliteration 'gong'; the proposed sentence is accurate.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 公戲二子曰：「徵舒似汝。」二子曰：「亦似公。」

decisions.reason: 莫之與京 uses 京 as 'to rival in greatness,' not a personal name Jing; the replacement correctly restores the oracle formula.

decisions.after: In the seventh year, the three younger brothers of Crown Prince Mian of Duke Huan, whom Duke Li had killed—the eldest named Yue, the middle named Lin, the youngest named Chu Jiu—together commanded the Cai people to lure Duke Li with beautiful women, and together with the Cai people killed Duke Li and established Yue, who became Duke Ligong.
decisions.reason: 厲公 and 利公 are distinct titles both often rendered Duke Li; the proposal rightly marks the accession title, but the English field cannot embed Chinese characters, so Ligong disambiguates in Latin script.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 與蔡人共殺厲公而立躍，是為利公。

decisions.reason: 縣陳 is the verbal use of 縣, 'make Chen a county,' not 'suspend'; the proposed wording matches the annexation sense.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 已誅徵舒，因縣陳而有之

decisions.reason: 倍楚盟 means Chen turned against/betrayed the Chu covenant; 'doubled-crossed' is a misleading calque of 倍.
The telegraphic literal drops the agent and obscures the 輕/重 contrast of valuing a word above a thousand-chariot state; the repair restores grammatical English without changing sense.
招之殺悼太子也 is a topical 'when Zhao killed Crown Prince Dao' clause; 'Zhao what killed' misreads 之, and 出奔晉 needs 'fled to Jin.'

sourceWitness.excerpt: 招之殺悼太子也，太子之子名吳，出奔晉。

decisions.reason: The original literal is ungrammatical telegraphic English; the proposed wording restores clause structure while preserving 平王, 悼太子師, 陳侯, and 惠公.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 平王初立，欲得和諸侯，乃求故陳悼太子師之子吳，立為陳侯，是為惠公。

decisions.reason: 故陳悼太子師 is Chen's former Crown Prince Dao (name Shi); 'Duke Dao of Chen' invents a ruler the Chinese does not name.
夏后禹 is Yu of the Xia rulers, and 之後苗裔 is singular descendant language; 'Xiahou Yu's descendants posterity' is both ungrammatical and misnames 夏后.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 杞東樓公者，夏后禹之後苗裔也。

decisions.reason: 悼公成 gives posthumous title Duke Dao and personal name Cheng only; the invented 'Li' has no source in the Chinese.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 平公十八年卒，子悼公成立。

decisions.reason: 契 is the Shang ancestor Xie; rendering him as 'Qi' wrongly conflates him with the state 杞 treated in neighboring sentences.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 禹之後，周武王封之杞……契之後為殷

decisions.reason: 齊湣王 is explicitly a king (王), not a duke; correcting to King Min restores the title.
其后 is temporal 'afterward,' not 'his descendants'; the original invents a kinship between King Hui of Chu and King Gou Jian of Yue.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 楚惠王滅杞，其後越王句踐興。
